messages.subject: Error in muthen1984
parts:
I have a dataset of 18 ordered factors, and I am trying to fit a model to predict factor scores.

vars <- c(paste0("item", seq(from=1, to=18, by=1)))
mod <- paste("scale", "=~", paste(vars, collapse="+"))
fit <- sem(mod, data = dat, meanstructure=TRUE, missing = "pairwise", estimator = "WLSMV")

I'm getting an error for an internal function muthen1984:

Error in muthen1984(Data = X[[g]], ov.names = ov.names[[g]], ov.types = ov.types,  : 
  lavaan ERROR: some categories of variable `item11' are empty in group 1; frequencies are [158 29 13 1 0]

This thread suggested updating lavaan, but I am using lavaan_0.5-20, R version 3.1.2.

I don't think I have a software issue though.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Error in muthen1984
parts:
On 01/10/2016 05:56 AM, Eric Green wrote:
> I'm getting an error for an internal function muthen1984:
>
> Error in muthen1984(Data = X[[g]], ov.names = ov.names[[g]], ov.types =
> ov.types, :
> lavaan ERROR: some categories of variable `item11' are empty in group
> 1; frequencies are [158 29 13 1 0]
>
> suggested updating lavaan, but I am using lavaan_0.5-20, R version 3.1.2.

This is another problem: you seem to have 5 categories (at least for
item11), but in group 1, the 4th category only has 1 observation, and
the last category has no observations. Therefore, we can not estimate
threshold values for this item11 in group 1.

Usually, this happens if the sample is too small (in this group), or if
the item is very skewed, or both.

The only solution is to collapse categories for those items (take
together category 4 and 5), in all groups.

You can screen your variables before the analysis using the lavTables()
function:

lavTables(dat, dim = 1)

Yves.
